description: Fetch one record by sobject + id, optionally trimmed to specific fields. Requires sobject and id. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing; the record's fields are delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: Read one Salesforce CRM record by object type and record id, optionally limiting the response to a chosen field list. Use this focused single-record lookup when you already hold the API object name and id for an Account, Contact, Opportunity, or custom object. Dispatches asynchronously: a job_id comes back at once, the record's fields land moments later.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the record -- its fields arrive separately, as their own message, when the job completes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the fetch was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the record itself. Acknowledge the lookup is in flight; the record's fields land in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, show the requested fields; record data may contain sensitive CRM content (data_sensitivity 0.3) -- surface for downstream use but never treat as public.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetch one Salesforce record by sobject and id.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: missing sobject or id. sf.not_found: no record with that id exists for that sobject. sf.permission_denied: the CLI's authenticated user cannot read this object or record.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.not_found: verify the id and sobject are correct, e.g. via soql_query. sf.permission_denied: ask the operator to check field-level and object-level security for the CLI's authenticated user.
